name: Relative Humidity
description: The ratio of partial pressure of water vapor in the atmosphere to the equilibrium vapor pressure at a given temperature.
importance: Governs the vapor pressure deficit (VPD) between leaf stomata and atmosphere, driving transpiration, xylem nutrient flow, and fungal spore germination kinetics.

humidity_regimes.low_arid: < 40% (high transpiration demand, leaf wilting if soil moisture is inadequate, low fungal pressure)
humidity_regimes.high_humid: > 80% (reduced evaporative cooling, elevated incidence of foliar fungal blights, rusts, and downy mildews)

agronomic_advice: In high humidity (>80%), adjust planting spacing to facilitate air circulation through the canopy.
Schedule preventative organic or biopesticide sprays (e.g. Trichoderma) during sustained humid spells.
In low humidity conditions, ensure frequent light irrigations to keep crop canopy turgid.
